snp1.5:7.2: A “corrupter of families” is a monk who wins a family’s affection by doing favors for them that aren’t proper for a monk to do, pulling their faith away from those who actually keep the Dhamma and Vinaya. See The Buddhist Monastic Code, Saṅghādisesa 13.
snp1.5:8.3: “That one” refers back to the path-corrupter described in the preceding verse.
